publishedApps.name: Habit Buddy
publishedApps.description: Habit Buddy is the ultimate habit tracking app for anyone looking to build consistency and transform their life through better daily habits. Whether you want to exercise more, read daily, meditate, or develop any positive habit — Habit Buddy makes it easy, beautiful, and completely private.
